challenge.better_approach: Considered: (1) a fixture under a sandbox-bound path: measured not the cause (same mount ns and /tmp; the answerer is on another box); (2) call TesterDevice()._handle_run in-process: no longer the bus verb the tooth exists to cover (RULE 1 caller shape); (3) unset CAIRN_BUS_HOME in-process: the bus client reads it at construction across the process; a child is the established isolation (test_root_verb_vocabulary._run). Chose (3') the child.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a scratch-HOME bus holding 'tester' answers the run verb with this checkout's code (it spawns from this class root), and that its shutdown leaves nothing: measured, no machines.bus process after two runs.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py home_env (ticket 3301915df481, the same Dell-bus leak measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus); cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_root_verb_vocabulary.py _run/_stop_bus; congruency-lab: no intention on a proof's bus locality beyond 3301915df481.
challenge.real_collision: One bus per cairn instance: not a collision; the scratch bus serves a scratch HOME on a throwaway table (remote.py ensure_bus decision 11), never the live instance.

answers.falsifier: RED if, with CAIRN_BUS_HOME naming another box's bus, the tooth's run-verb ask is answered by a tester that cannot see the fixture; or if the proof leaves a scratch bus process running.
answers.how: Reading 1's ask moves into a child of the proof (--ask-run <path>) run under a scratch HOME built by cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.home_env, which drops every CAIRN_BUS_*; the child's reach('tester') lazy-inits a throwaway-table bus under that HOME; the parent shuts that bus down after. Only the proof file changes.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (a tooth measures the thing it names; a red from asking another box's tester about this box's disk measures the route, not the door) and Law 8 (a proof must be runnable on the box that builds it).
answers.what: The coverage tooth of test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped asks the tester's run verb of a bus on the same box as its fixture, so the run reads the fixture it names on every box, whatever CAIRN_BUS_HOME the session carries.

bullets.text: Any proof that hands a local path to a bus verb is box-bound while sessions carry a far CAIRN_BUS_HOME; this is the second instance after 3301915df481.
